chapter_seo_title: Han Li Plans a Night Raid Against the Black Fiend Sect
chapter_meta_description: Han Li returns with the rescued Five Friends of Meng Mountain and lays out a cold, calculated plan to strike the Black Fiend Sect before dawn. But his real motive is longer-term.
og_title: Han Li Plans a Night Raid Against the Black Fiend Sect
og_description: Han Li returns with the rescued Five Friends of Meng Mountain and lays out a cold, calculated plan to strike the Black Fiend Sect before dawn. But his real motive is longer-term.
twitter_title: Night Raid Prep: Han Li's Cold Calculus
twitter_description: Han Li cleanses the Five Friends of Meng Mountain, but his plan to strike at night hides a deeper strategy: turning them into long-term assets.

lore_anchors.definition: A dark ritual restriction placed on a subordinate’s body, allowing a master to inflict punishment or trigger a pre-determined death remotely; a common institutional leash in the cultivation world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Han Li just control the Five Friends of Meng Mountain with poison or restrictions?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He considers it but decides against it because forced control breeds eventual betrayal; he wants them as willing long-term agents for gathering pill formulas.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is Han Li’s real plan for the Five Friends?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He sees them as ideal candidates to help him collect pill formulas and herbs in the future, so he can focus on full-time cultivation instead of running around.
